endpoints.name: SearchPartners
endpoints.description: Performs simple text search across multiple partner fields (name, description, etc.). This endpoint supports basic text search using the `searchText` parameter. For more advanced, structured searches, use the `AdvancedSearchPartners` endpoint.

request.description: Pagination request containing only pagination and sorting parameters

endpoints.name: AdvancedSearchPartners
endpoints.description: Performs advanced search with structured criteria including status, dates, relationships, and complex filters. This endpoint allows for highly specific searches using the `searchCriteria` parameter, which expects a JSON array of objects. Each object should have `field`, `operator`, and `value` properties. For example: `[{"field": "name", "operator": "like", "value": "Foundation"}, {"field": "status", "operator": "is", "value": "Active"}]`. Available fields for search include: `id`, `name`, `status`, `newEngagement`, `phone`, `website`, `shortName`, `organizationHierarchyId`, `organizationHierarchyName`, `partnerCategoryId`, `partnerCategoryName`, `addressCity`, `addressStateProvince`, `addressPostalCode`, `addressCountry`, `description`, `email`, `createdDate`, `modifiedDate`, and nested field `contact.firstName`. Available operators are: `like`, `is`, `not`, `contains`, `startsWith`, `endsWith`, `between`, `greaterThan`, `lessThan`, `greaterThanOrEqual`, `lessThanOrEqual`, `on`, `not on`, `this week`, `this month`, `this year`. Date fields are `createdDate`, `modifiedDate`.

request.description: Pagination request containing only pagination and sorting parameters

searchCriteria.description: JSON array of search criteria objects with field, operator, value, and logicalOperator

searchText.description: Optional additional text search to combine with criteria

example_uses: Find active government partners
Show partners with global key account status
Get partners created this month
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this for searches involving partner status, dates, types, complex criteria, or multiple field combinations.
